items.subject: Updates to your branded content toolkit on YouTube
items.summary: YouTube announced new branded content labels and tools, plus auto-detection of undeclared paid promotions.
items.body:
Supporting your brand partnerships on YouTube

We know brand partnerships are critical for growing your business and deepening your connection with your community. To help you maintain transparency with viewers and strengthen relationships with brand partners, we've introduced several features that streamline how you disclose paid content.

These updates include refreshed, viewer-facing labels for branded content, as well as age and location controls to help you navigate regional requirements. As we shared in September, we're also starting to roll out automated detection for undeclared brand deals and may start auto-labeling content we detect as paid promotion that wasn't declared.

While these tools are designed to help, as a creator, you are responsible for ensuring your branded content is properly disclosed and follows our policies and all legal regulatory requirements.

What's in your branded content toolkit?

Clarified global policy
In September we updated YouTube policy guidelines to standardize terminology around "branded content" and clarify regulatory disclosure obligations and applicable Google Ads policy.

Redesigned viewer labels
Viewers now see a refreshed, simpler paid promotion label.

items.body:
A brief summary of the World Cube Association forum since 2026-10-29.

3 New Topics

93 New Users

Popular Topics

Please don't remove Clock
A member argues Clock should stay as a WCA event and that FTO should replace FMC instead, since Clock is popular and its records get broken more often.

Potential unfair penalties in 4pad
A member worries 4pad timers make it harder for judges to tell a DNF from an OK solve when a solver fixes a +2 right before stopping the timer.
